description_en: Lists the tags that are attached to specified resources
description_zh: 查询指定资源绑定的标签
name: ListTagResources

parameters.help_en:
The resource type. Valid values:

loadbalancer: a Gateway Load Balancer (GWLB) instance.

listener: a listener.

servergroup: a server group
parameters.help_zh:
资源类型，取值：

loadbalancer：网关型负载均衡实例。
listener：监听。
servergroup：服务器组
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en: A list of resource IDs. You can specify up to 50 resource IDs in each call
parameters.help_zh: 资源 ID列表。一次调用最多支持添加 50 个资源 ID
parameters.name: resource_id

parameters.help_en: A list of tags. You can specify up to 20 tags in each call
parameters.help_zh: 标签列表。一次调用最多支持 20 个标签
parameters.name: tag

parameters.help_en:
The token that is used to retrieve the next page of results. Valid values:

If the NextToken parameter is empty, it indicates that no subsequent query is required.

If a value is returned for NextToken, the value is the token that is used to retrieve the next page of results
parameters.help_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
如果NextToken为空表示没有下一次查询。
如果NextToken有返回值，该取值表示下一次查询开始的令牌
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. Valid values: 1 to 1000. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 使用NextToken方式查询时，每次最多返回的结果数。取值范围：1~1000。默认值：20
parameters.name: max_results

NextToken.description_en:
The token that is used to retrieve the next page of results. Valid values:

If the NextToken parameter is empty, it indicates that no subsequent query is required.

If a value is returned for NextToken, the value is the token that is used to retrieve the next page of results
NextToken.description_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
如果NextToken为空表示没有下一次查询。
如果NextToken有返回值，该取值表示下一次查询开始的令牌
